title: A Power Outage at Home
paragraphs: Hadi's family is cooking dinner when the power goes out. The whole neighborhood is dark. Half of their meal is still on the stove.
Hadi's wife lights some candles from a drawer. Hadi asks the neighbors if the whole street has the same problem.
The family finishes a simple dinner on a small gas burner. The children think the candlelight dinner is exciting, not only difficult.
Two hours later, the power returns. The family agrees that the unplanned dinner became one of their most memorable evenings that month.
